note: Exporter identity confirmed by customs records, not by website claims. Two outbound shipments are documented: HS 38021000 activated carbon to Novorossiysk, Russia (B/L 7243867, 2024-02-03) and HS 84051090 nitrogen gas generation plant to Tema, Ghana (B/L 2176805, 2024-07-04). Declared HS 380210 matches the Russia shipment exactly; the Ghana shipment is a different product line (8405), so the company ships both activated carbon and PSA plant equipment — HS 380210 is correct but not exhaustive. One inbound record (activated carbon from Kurary Co Ltd, Kobe, Japan, B/L 9648832, 2024-01-13) shows it also imports raw material, consistent with a converter/trader role rather than pure manufacturer. Registered address per customs data: D-9/6 1st Floor, Okhla Industrial Area Phase-I, New Delhi 110020. Note the counterparty list shows GAMMAECOPROM LLC linked to both PSA NITROGEN LIMITED and NSI ENGINEERING PRIVATE LIMITED — possible group/agent relationship, worth checking for related-party routing. Domestic supply side is genuinely unverified, not negative: absence of evidence here reflects tool access failure, not absence of supplies. Export activity appears to have stopped after July 2024 in the visible record set — no 2025-2026 shipments seen, though the free view may be truncated.
